outcome: achievement of target systolic blood pressure 140-150 and diastolic blood pressure 90-100 mm Hg after the first bolus
cohort: Thai women treated with intravenous hydralazine or labetalol for systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥160 or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥110 mm Hg from January 2011 to December 2013
finding: Intravenous labetalol was associated with a significantly higher rate of timely achievement of target blood pressure compared to intravenous hydralazine.
